name: Uma Converter Ltd.
summary: Uma Converter Ltd. is an Indian manufacturer and exporter of flexible packaging materials, specializing in a wide range of packaging solutions. The company's primary products include multi-color laminated rolls, various types of pouches such as vacuum, zipper, stand-up, and spout pouches, as well as multi-layer films including LD/LLDPE and stretch films. These packaging materials are crafted from diverse substrates like polyethylene terephthalate, biaxially-oriented polypropylene, polythene, cast polypropylene, foil, paper, and biodegradable films. Uma Converter Ltd. serves a broad spectrum of industries including food, beverages, pharmaceuticals, and personal care, catering to both domestic and international markets with exports to countries like Saudi Arabia, Australia, Senegal, and the United States of America.
